full_prompt_en: A square, polished illustrative portrait shows a young woman with a dark bob haircut against a densely patterned field of yellow flowers and teal birds. Her head and shoulders fill the center, while the background remains equally active right out to the corners. The hair is cut into a rounded shape at the jaw and across the forehead, with individual dark curves softening the otherwise clean silhouette. Her pale face looks straight ahead. Olive-green eyes, fine dark lashes, peach cheeks, and softly parted pink lips are rendered with smooth tonal transitions and thin contour lines. She wears a bright mustard-yellow short-sleeved shirt with a pointed collar and small buttons down the center. A slim black ribbon is tied at the neck, and two dark vertical straps run down over the shoulders, adding strong linear accents to the broad yellow garment. Around her, large yellow blossoms overlap stylized blue-green birds. Wings open diagonally at the upper left and right, and smaller birds cross behind the shoulders, their feathers organized in graphic parallel strokes. Pale cream areas and yellow foliage fill the gaps, so there is little empty ground. The birds and flowers do not form a deep landscape; they behave as layered decorative silhouettes immediately behind the subject. The illustration has crisp edges and fine line details, with subtle grain in flat color and restrained shading on the face. Light is bright and even from the upper front, giving the skin gentle highlights while the patterned background remains evenly colored without strong shadows. The overall composition centers a calm, direct expression amid lively overlapping natural motifs, balancing mustard yellow against dark hair and cool teal movement.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、完成度精细的插画肖像描绘一位黑色波波短发年轻女子，背景密布黄花与青绿色鸟。头肩占据中央，图案背景一直活跃地延伸到四角。头发在下颌与额前剪成圆润形状，单独的深色弯线柔化原本干净的剪影。浅色面庞正视前方。橄榄绿眼睛、细深睫毛、桃色面颊和微张粉唇用平滑色调过渡与细轮廓线呈现。她穿鲜明芥黄色短袖衬衫，尖领，中央有一排小纽扣。颈间系着细黑丝带，两条深色纵向肩带垂过肩膀，为宽阔黄衣增添强烈线性重音。周围，大朵黄花与风格化蓝绿鸟互相叠压。鸟翼在左上和右上斜向展开，更小的鸟从肩后掠过，羽毛由图形化平行笔划组织。浅奶油色块与黄色枝叶填补间隙，几乎没有空地。鸟与花不构成深远风景，而是贴在人物背后层叠的装饰剪影。插画边缘清楚，细线细节丰富，平坦色彩带轻微颗粒，脸上阴影克制。光从前上方明亮均匀地照来，在皮肤上留下柔和高光，图案背景则均匀着色，无强影。整体构图把安静而直接的神情置于活跃重叠的自然纹样中，以芥黄平衡深发和冷青绿色运动。
style_prompt_en: The image has a polished illustrative finish with clean contours, fine interior lines, and lightly grained flat color. Warm yellow, cream, peach, and mustard form broad bright areas, while teal and blue-green motifs sweep through them in diagonal, overlapping rhythms. A compact dark mass and a few thin black linear accents stabilize the otherwise lively palette. Focal planes receive smooth, restrained modeling; surrounding forms remain flatter and more pattern-like. Light is bright and even, producing gentle highlights but little cast shadow. Depth is shallow, built from crisp overlaps and shifts in scale rather than atmospheric recession. The overall effect is decorative and poised, with dense movement held around a calm central shape.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有精致插画完成面，轮廓干净，内部细线丰富，平坦色彩略带颗粒。暖黄、奶油、桃色和芥黄形成宽阔亮区，青绿与蓝绿图案以斜向叠压节奏穿行其间。紧凑深色体块和少量细黑线性重音稳定原本活跃的色域。焦点平面获得平滑、克制的塑形，周围形体则更平、更像花纹。光明亮均匀，带来柔和高光而投影很少。纵深较浅，由清楚叠压与尺度变化建立，而非大气远近。整体效果装饰性强而沉稳，密集运动围绕安静中央形状展开。
theme_en: A dark-bobbed young woman in a yellow shirt amid teal birds and flowers
theme_zh: 黑色短发女子穿黄衬衫，周围是青绿色鸟与花朵
name: Martine Johanna
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
